'''Football Club Magpies''', also known as '''FC Magpies''', is a semi-professional [[Association football|football]] team from [[Gibraltar]]. They play in the [[Gibraltar Football League]] and the [[Rock Cup]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://gibraltarfa.com/domestic-football/cup/rock-cup|title=Gibraltar Football Association|access-date=2015-02-17|archive-date=2018-05-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180511145712/https://www.gibraltarfa.com/domestic-football/cup/rock-cup|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name="BBC">{{cite web | url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cw0yk2nz4q5o | title=Hops and dreams - the former pub team aiming to shock Europe|website=Bbc.co.uk | date=25 July 2024 | access-date=25 July 2024}}</ref> From 1 June 2025, '''Calpe City''' became part of the club."}}
